integrity: Self-contained proof and executable exact-rational finite-state checks; no independent validation or formal certificate.
scientific_limitations: Strict monotonicity is proved for t=2 with single-cooperator initial state after a rare mutant enters an all-defector population; N>=4, beta>0, delta<0, theta>=0, state-independent baseline payoff difference. Not proved for initial-state mixtures, higher t, general mutation, or general games.
title: Strict reward-cost monotonicity at the two-cooperator intervention threshold
